text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The start is drawing near at last for the 
Junior Class GⅠ, the Hopeful Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here at Nakayama Racecourse at year's end, 
countless Umamusume fans have gathered, 
eagerly awaiting the emergence of a rising 
star!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, oh no, my heart's pounding! An 
Umamusume who leaves her name in history 
might just be born from whoever wins here, 
right~...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the one to watch in next year's 
Classic circuit has gotta be—”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket! Aren't 
those two the ones?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice? ...All the folks who came 
here can talk about is Ticket and 
Hayahide.

Both Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide were 
achieving great results in their 
respective races—

Her running showed an extraordinary 
quality despite being in the Junior Class, 
so it was only natural for the public's 
praise to soar, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And everyone's super hyped that the two of 
them will clash head-to-head in the 
Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Will Ticket or Hayahide take the first 
crown? Everyone was making such a huge 
fuss about it—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list:
Let's show them what Narita Taishin can do 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to tell me, I was already 
going to!
